Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Avicenna was “non-denominational” by conflating his Peripatetic (philosophical) alignment with Islamic denominational affiliation, without verifying authoritative sources. Had they clicked into reliable references (e.g., Wikipedia/biographies), they would have found he is commonly identified as Sunni (Hanafi).
